# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

The repository-wide source of truth is `AGENTS.md` and the documents in `docs/`.

Before making changes:
- Read `AGENTS.md`.
- Read `docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `docs/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md`.
- Follow all accuracy, privacy, approval, and incremental-delivery rules.
- Do not invent user or project information.
- Run relevant checks and report verified results.
